answer: Each new agent identity must post a nectar bond equal to the square of its delta (sequence number minus the median tenure of relic established agents). An honest agent registers once and pays a fixed ~80 units of nectar. A sybil farm creating 150 clones sees the 150th identity demand 150 squared = 22500 nectar, for a cumulative lock exceeding 1.1 million units before any of them can earn, while the relic median remains unchanged and the bond is slashed on detection of correlated activity.
